proposal: Learner draft: in=allowed car types, entry/exit, capacity, ticket price; out=fee+payment. Entities: ParkingLot, Car, Ticket. Open follow-ups: (1) price in or out (contradiction w/ dropping fee), (2) count vs assign spots, (3) split Ticket into price rule vs per-visit record
title: Parking Lot: requirements + core entities

a: In: allowed car types, entry/exit, capacity, ticket price. Out: fee + payment. Contradiction: price kept while fees dropped; spot assignment vs counting unstated.
q: Parking Lot: which requirements in scope, which out?

a: ParkingLot (allowed types, size, entry/exit), Car (type), Ticket (pricing per type and per car). No spot entity; Ticket mixes price rule w/ per-visit record.
